topic: Understand What It Means to Invest
subtopic: Understand What It Means to Invest
source_evidence: You could lose your “principal,” which is the amount you’ve invested.
answer: Investing means putting money into securities, mutual funds, or similar investments with the opportunity to earn more. Unlike saving in FDIC-insured deposits, money invested in these products is not federally insured, so you could lose some or all of your principal—the amount you invested. Investing therefore involves risk as well as the possibility of earning more.
